epics.title: Payment Gateway Integration
epics.description: Integration with a payment gateway (Stripe) for credit card payments, subscription management, and payment event handling

stories.title: As a customer, I want to make credit card payments, so that I can purchase products and services
stories.description: Integrate Stripe payment gateway for credit card payments
acceptance_criteria: The system successfully processes a credit card payment and updates the order status
The system handles declined credit card payments and displays an error message to the customer

tasks.title: Setup Stripe payment gateway API
tasks.description: Configure Stripe API keys and setup payment gateway

tasks.title: Implement credit card payment processing
tasks.description: Develop functionality to process credit card payments using Stripe API

tasks.title: Test credit card payment processing
tasks.description: Test credit card payment processing with different payment scenarios

stories.title: As a customer, I want to manage my subscriptions, so that I can update or cancel my recurring payments
stories.description: Integrate Stripe subscription management for recurring payments
acceptance_criteria: The system successfully updates a customer's subscription plan and notifies the customer via email
The system cancels a customer's subscription and stops recurring payments

tasks.title: Implement subscription plan management
tasks.description: Develop functionality to update and cancel subscription plans using Stripe API

tasks.title: Develop subscription management UI
tasks.description: Design and develop a user interface for customers to manage their subscriptions

tasks.title: Test subscription management functionality
tasks.description: Test subscription management functionality with different subscription scenarios

stories.title: As a system administrator, I want to receive payment event notifications, so that I can track and manage payment-related activities
stories.description: Integrate Stripe webhook for payment event handling and notification
acceptance_criteria: The system successfully receives and processes payment event notifications from Stripe
The system sends email notifications to customers and administrators for successful payments and payment-related events

tasks.title: Setup Stripe webhook for payment events
tasks.description: Configure Stripe webhook to receive payment event notifications

tasks.title: Implement payment event handling and notification
tasks.description: Develop functionality to handle payment event notifications and send email notifications

tasks.title: Test payment event handling and notification
tasks.description: Test payment event handling and notification with different payment scenarios

epics.title: User Authentication System
epics.description: A comprehensive system for user authentication, including login, signup, password reset, and OAuth integration

stories.title: As a user, I want to login to the system using my email and password, so that I can access the application's features
stories.description: The system should allow users to login using their email and password, and redirect them to the dashboard after a successful login
acceptance_criteria: The system redirects the user to the dashboard after a successful login
The system displays an error message when the user enters an incorrect email or password
The system remembers the user's login credentials for a specified period

tasks.title: Implement email and password login functionality
tasks.description: Create a login form that accepts email and password, and authenticates the user using a backend API

tasks.title: Create a dashboard page for logged-in users
tasks.description: Design and implement a dashboard page that displays user information and application features

tasks.title: Implement session management for logged-in users
tasks.description: Create a session management system that stores user data and remembers login credentials for a specified period

stories.title: As a new user, I want to sign up for an account, so that I can use the application's features
stories.description: The system should allow new users to sign up for an account, and send a verification email to confirm their email address
acceptance_criteria: The system sends a verification email to the user's email address after sign up
The system displays an error message when the user enters an invalid email address or password
The system creates a new user account after the user confirms their email address

tasks.title: Implement user sign up functionality
tasks.description: Create a sign up form that accepts user information, and creates a new user account in the database

tasks.title: Create an email verification system
tasks.description: Design and implement an email verification system that sends a verification email to the user's email address

tasks.title: Implement password hashing and storage
tasks.description: Create a password hashing and storage system that securely stores user passwords in the database

stories.title: As a user, I want to reset my password, so that I can recover my account if I forget my password
stories.description: The system should allow users to reset their password, and send a password reset email to their email address
acceptance_criteria: The system sends a password reset email to the user's email address
The system displays an error message when the user enters an invalid email address
The system updates the user's password after the user resets their password

tasks.title: Implement password reset functionality
tasks.description: Create a password reset form that accepts the user's email address, and sends a password reset email to the user's email address

tasks.title: Create a password reset email template
tasks.description: Design and implement a password reset email template that contains a password reset link

tasks.title: Implement password update functionality
tasks.description: Create a password update system that updates the user's password in the database after the user resets their password

stories.title: As a user, I want to login to the system using my Google or GitHub account, so that I can access the application's features without creating a new account
stories.description: The system should allow users to login using their Google or GitHub account, and authenticate them using OAuth
acceptance_criteria: The system redirects the user to the Google or GitHub authorization page after the user clicks the login button
The system displays an error message when the user's Google or GitHub account is not authorized
The system creates a new user account after the user authorizes their Google or GitHub account

tasks.title: Implement Google OAuth integration
tasks.description: Create a Google OAuth integration that authenticates the user using their Google account

tasks.title: Implement GitHub OAuth integration
tasks.description: Create a GitHub OAuth integration that authenticates the user using their GitHub account

tasks.title: Implement OAuth callback handling
tasks.description: Create an OAuth callback handling system that handles the OAuth callback from Google or GitHub, and creates a new user account if necessary

epics.title: Email Notification System
epics.description: A system for sending transactional emails to users for important events

stories.title: As a system administrator, I want to integrate the email notification system with SendGrid, so that transactional emails can be sent reliably
stories.description: Integrate the email notification system with SendGrid to enable reliable transactional email sending
acceptance_criteria: The system can send emails to users using SendGrid
Emails are delivered to the user's inbox within 5 minutes of triggering the email event
The system handles SendGrid API errors and retries failed email sends

tasks.title: Setup SendGrid API credentials and configure the email service
tasks.description: Create a SendGrid account, generate API credentials, and configure the email service to use SendGrid

tasks.title: Implement email sending logic using the SendGrid API
tasks.description: Write code to send emails using the SendGrid API, including handling API errors and retries

tasks.title: Test and verify SendGrid integration with the email notification system
tasks.description: Test the SendGrid integration by sending test emails and verifying delivery and error handling

stories.title: As a user, I want to receive welcome emails with personalized content, so that I feel engaged with the platform
stories.description: Send welcome emails to new users with personalized content to enhance their onboarding experience
acceptance_criteria: Welcome emails are sent to new users within 1 hour of account creation
Welcome emails contain personalized content, including the user's name and a brief introduction to the platform
Welcome emails include a call-to-action to encourage users to explore the platform

tasks.title: Design and implement email templates for welcome emails
tasks.description: Create email templates for welcome emails, including personalized content and a call-to-action

tasks.title: Implement logic to trigger welcome emails on user account creation
tasks.description: Write code to trigger welcome emails when a new user account is created

tasks.title: Test and verify welcome email sending and content
tasks.description: Test the welcome email sending process and verify that emails are delivered with the correct content

stories.title: As a user, I want to receive password reset links via email, so that I can recover my account
stories.description: Send password reset links to users via email to enable account recovery
acceptance_criteria: Password reset links are sent to users via email within 1 minute of requesting a password reset
Password reset links are valid for 30 minutes and can be used to reset the user's password
The system prevents brute-force attacks on password reset links

tasks.title: Implement password reset link generation and email sending
tasks.description: Write code to generate password reset links and send them to users via email

tasks.title: Implement password reset link validation and expiration
tasks.description: Write code to validate password reset links and expire them after 30 minutes

tasks.title: Test and verify password reset link sending and validation
tasks.description: Test the password reset link sending process and verify that links are valid and expire correctly

stories.title: As a system administrator, I want to track and monitor email sending metrics, so that I can optimize the email notification system
stories.description: Track and monitor email sending metrics to optimize the email notification system
acceptance_criteria: The system tracks and displays email sending metrics, including delivery rates and bounce rates
The system provides alerts and notifications for email sending errors and issues
The system integrates with analytics tools to provide insights into email sending performance

tasks.title: Implement email sending metrics tracking and display
tasks.description: Write code to track and display email sending metrics, including delivery rates and bounce rates

tasks.title: Implement alerts and notifications for email sending errors and issues
tasks.description: Write code to provide alerts and notifications for email sending errors and issues

tasks.title: Integrate with analytics tools to provide insights into email sending performance
tasks.description: Integrate the email notification system with analytics tools to provide insights into email sending performance

epics.title: Admin Dashboard
epics.description: A dashboard for internal team to manage users, monitor the platform, and view analytics

stories.title: As an admin, I want to manage users, so that I can control access to the platform
stories.description: The admin dashboard should allow administrators to create, edit, and delete user accounts
acceptance_criteria: The dashboard displays a list of all user accounts
Admins can create new user accounts with unique usernames and passwords
Admins can edit existing user account details, including roles and permissions
Admins can delete user accounts, with a confirmation prompt to prevent accidental deletion

tasks.title: Design and implement user account management UI
tasks.description: Create a user-friendly interface for managing user accounts

tasks.title: Develop user account creation and editing functionality
tasks.description: Write backend code to handle user account creation and editing

tasks.title: Implement user account deletion with confirmation prompt
tasks.description: Add a confirmation prompt to prevent accidental user account deletion

stories.title: As an admin, I want to view analytics dashboards, so that I can monitor platform performance
stories.description: The admin dashboard should display key metrics and analytics to help administrators understand platform performance
acceptance_criteria: The dashboard displays real-time metrics, including active users and revenue
The dashboard displays system performance metrics, including response times and error rates
The dashboard allows admins to filter metrics by date range and other criteria
The dashboard displays visualizations of key metrics, including charts and graphs

tasks.title: Design and implement analytics dashboard UI
tasks.description: Create a user-friendly interface for displaying analytics and metrics

tasks.title: Develop backend API to retrieve and process metrics data
tasks.description: Write backend code to handle data retrieval and processing for analytics dashboards

tasks.title: Implement data visualization library for analytics dashboards
tasks.description: Integrate a data visualization library to display charts and graphs

stories.title: As an admin, I want to monitor system health, so that I can identify and resolve issues
stories.description: The admin dashboard should display system health metrics and alerts to help administrators identify and resolve issues
acceptance_criteria: The dashboard displays system health metrics, including CPU usage and memory usage
The dashboard displays alerts and notifications for system issues, including error logs
The dashboard allows admins to view detailed system logs and error messages
The dashboard displays a system status indicator, including green/yellow/red status lights

tasks.title: Design and implement system health monitoring UI
tasks.description: Create a user-friendly interface for displaying system health metrics and alerts

tasks.title: Develop backend API to retrieve and process system health data
tasks.description: Write backend code to handle data retrieval and processing for system health monitoring

tasks.title: Implement system log and error message viewer
tasks.description: Add a viewer for system logs and error messages, with filtering and search functionality

stories.title: As an admin, I want to manage configuration, so that I can customize platform settings
stories.description: The admin dashboard should allow administrators to manage configuration settings, including platform-wide settings and user-specific settings
acceptance_criteria: The dashboard displays a list of configurable settings, including platform-wide and user-specific settings
Admins can edit existing configuration settings, including text fields and dropdown menus
Admins can add new configuration settings, with validation and error handling
The dashboard displays a confirmation prompt to prevent accidental changes to configuration settings

tasks.title: Design and implement configuration management UI
tasks.description: Create a user-friendly interface for managing configuration settings

tasks.title: Develop backend API to retrieve and process configuration data
tasks.description: Write backend code to handle data retrieval and processing for configuration management

tasks.title: Implement configuration setting validation and error handling
tasks.description: Add validation and error handling for configuration settings, including input validation and error messages

stories.title: As an admin, I want to view real-time metrics, so that I can monitor platform activity
stories.description: The admin dashboard should display real-time metrics, including active users and revenue, to help administrators monitor platform activity
acceptance_criteria: The dashboard displays real-time metrics, including active users and revenue
The dashboard updates metrics in real-time, with a refresh interval of 1 minute or less
The dashboard displays a historical view of metrics, including daily and weekly trends
The dashboard allows admins to filter metrics by date range and other criteria

tasks.title: Design and implement real-time metrics UI
tasks.description: Create a user-friendly interface for displaying real-time metrics

tasks.title: Develop backend API to retrieve and process real-time metrics data
tasks.description: Write backend code to handle data retrieval and processing for real-time metrics

tasks.title: Implement real-time data streaming and updates
tasks.description: Add real-time data streaming and updates, with a refresh interval of 1 minute or less
